rationale: This randomized pilot feasibility study evaluates a Community Health Worker home-visiting behavioural intervention targeting caregiver mental health, early childhood development, parenting practices, and household violence in Sierra Leone. It has no connection to household or community water or sanitation service access (fails Criterion 1 and Criterion 4; excluded under E01).
plain_vs_narrow_note: Both readings exclude the record under E01 because the study concerns a home-visiting behavioural intervention for caregiver mental health, parenting practices, and household violence prevention rather than water or sanitation service access.

evidence_quotes.quote: Task-sharing to promote caregiver mental health, positive parenting practices, and violence prevention in vulnerable families in Sierra Leone: a pilot feasibility study

Research assistants blinded to treatment assignment assessed caregiver mental health, caregiver-child interactions, and household violence at baseline, post-intervention, and 3-month follow-up time points.
